description: S52 T4 (LM1, LM4): the agent's ONE memory write. learnings.mine.add files under a STAMPED scope — agent scope under the caller's own slug, project scope under the step's own component root; a scopeKey naming anything else is refused below the schema, and person scope has no agent door at all. Provenance is observed or assumed: told is a person's word and relayed the board hook's, and neither is nameable here by field or by service (LM4). The answer is the same LearningsItemResult rendering as show's. Rate-capped (32 adds per 24h per agent, counted off the audit ledger), body 2048 bytes, 8 tags.

params.body: the balance column is built from the rendered table struct's tags — a missing column is the tag list, not the writer loop
